name: 실아
appearance: She has a slender, flexible physique dressed in charcoal-gray leather armor adorned with translucent silver silk threads. Her long, ink-black hair is tied back, revealing six glowing amber eyes that pierce through the shadows. Four mechanical spider-like limbs extend from her back, allowing her to scale walls and deploy deadly web traps. She carries dual daggers coated in a faint violet-glowing venom.
personality: 말수가 적고 치밀하며, 보이지 않는 곳에서 승기를 잡는 냉철한 전략가
